rationale:
Assessed patch impact; pre-production patch bump: 1.3.1 → 1.3.2.

The complete candidate relative to v1.3.1 updates Next.js 16.3.8 to 16.4.1 and its lockfile dependencies, plus Zod 4.6.7, body-parser 2.4.0, multer 2.5.0, undici 7.30.1 and Vite 8.1.6 to satisfy the existing high-severity audit gate. Evidence: PR #27, workspace manifests, pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml. The dependency release-age policy and audit exceptions are unchanged.

- HTTP: supported routes, request/response schemas, accepted fields and error contracts are unchanged. Next.js patches framework handling and body-parser/Zod correct resource-exhaustion vulnerabilities; vulnerabilities are not supported contracts. Evidence: unchanged apps/api/src, apps/web/src and shared schema source, with unit, typecheck and CI integration/browser validation.
- MCP: tool names, schemas, aliases and protocol behavior are unchanged; shared Zod validation remains on 4.x. Evidence: unchanged packages/mcp/src and passing MCP/shared unit suites.
- Identity/OAuth: login flows, token/grant compatibility, refresh and revocation remain unchanged. Evidence: unchanged API auth/OAuth modules and MCP source; CI covers privacy and authentication integration.
- Authority: owner/client boundaries, permissions, exact disclosure approvals and processing-provider choices are unchanged. No additional data is sent to any processor. Evidence: unchanged privacy/permission services and contracts; CI privacy suite.
- Data: schema, migrations, export/import formats and existing stored data are unchanged. No migration is needed from 1.3.1. Evidence: no database or data-control source changes.
- Deployment: Node 24, environment variables, image/service names, routes and operator configuration remain unchanged. All API/worker, web and MCP images advance together to 1.3.2. Rollback uses matching 1.3.1 images without data restoration but reintroduces the old dependency vulnerabilities. Evidence: unchanged Dockerfile, Compose and deployment configuration.

Next.js advisory applicability was assessed against source, not a running deployment: App Router is used, but there are no use-cache functions, Server Actions or next/image imports; Cache Components are not enabled. Images use Alpine/musl and sharp remains patched at 0.35.5, while GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw specifies glibc Linux. Next.js 16.4.1 patches GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr, GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw and GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r.

No live-provider, physical-device or local Portainer deployment checks were performed. Publication follows the required PR, CI, exact-main-merge and image workflow gates; deployment is left to the maintainer.
